_comment: Emulator-authored world knowledge for POST /search/knowledge-hybrid (docs/agent-engine.md). Each entry is one short fact; entries must not contain the text ', Distance:'. None of this text was recovered from the official service.
entries: A house mate lives in your home, keeps it in order and can be invited or dismissed from the house mate dialogue.
House mates remember the conversations they have with the people they live with.
Gardens near a home can grow vegetables and herbs that are useful for cooking.
Cooking turns gathered ingredients into meals that restore strength after a long journey.
Village markets are where traders sell produce, crafted goods and supplies.
Trade packs are carried from one region to another and sold for a better price far from where they were made.
Travelers rest at inns and campfires to recover before continuing on the road.
Monsters roam the wilds outside the villages, and travelers should carry proper weapons and armor.
Quests are tasks that villagers ask of adventurers in exchange for rewards.
Mounts let travelers cross long distances quickly, and some vehicles can carry trade packs.
Guilds are groups of adventurers who help one another and share a common name.
Mail lets people send letters and parcels to each other across the continent.
Gathering herbs, ore and wood provides materials for crafting.
The day is divided into morning, afternoon, evening and night, and many villagers follow a daily routine.
A warm meal, a clean house and good company make a home worth returning to.
